name: tracker-refused-flag-delivery
goal: A tighter tracker flag contract never silently drops a machine alert: monitors have 'tracker alert', every refused flag is kept for Chief of Staff, and unattended callers are contract-tested

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Brief ksyxq7: since the structured-flag rule the CLI refuses a legacy 'tracker flag <id> <msg>' before it reaches the service; monitors that discard stderr lose every alert. Reproduced by running the strengthened CLI tests on 7b36a973a2. Expected: a supported alert verb, every refused flag kept on its item or the CoS inbox, unattended caller shapes contract-tested.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: tracker-flag-structured.test.ts only asserted that nativeTrackerArgs throws; it never ran the CLI against the item API, never asserted what happens to the refused message, and held no unattended caller argument shapes. Gap closed with a shared real-CLI channel fixture and a caller inventory fixture.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed tests fail on unchanged product code: 9 failed, 23 passed; assertion: expected the CLI output to contain 'kept for Chief of Staff'.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: tracker alert verb; refused flags (parser or service refusal) kept on the item and CoS inbox; inbox messages survive finished or unknown targets and are sent first; unattended caller inventory contract test.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: loop record --phase green passed at the separate fix commit with unchanged tests.

steps.title: Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
